title: Enemy Horizontal Motion Floating in Mid-Air Past Platform Edge
explanation: At frame 952 (t=16.32s), enemy FloatingEnemy traversed past the platform edge at (7200, 550) and continued moving horizontally while suspended in mid-air without falling. Traced to Enemy.gd:L35-L48 where is_floating_bug overrides vertical velocity to 0.0 when not on floor, violating physical gravity and actor kinematics.
repro_hint: Observe FloatingEnemy on Map2 when it reaches the platform edge; it floats forward horizontally.
